scope: 24 manually labelled banking requests, including one known in-prompt regression; not a general Arabic benchmark
comparison: Deployed pipelines: Qwen2.5-1.5B FP32 Transformers vs Qwen3.5-4B Q4_K_M llama.cpp CPU. Same messages and tool validation, 4 CPU threads, no reasoning, deterministic decoding. llama.cpp additionally constrains JSON schema. Startup and one warmup excluded. Prefix reuse may benefit llama.cpp; speed difference is not attributable to model alone.
